gen-press-start-2p-gf-athiti: Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart, with a faint modulation you only catch up close. And Athiti follows in a plain sans, its lines like vinyl cut to one width, so a shrunken heading would still hold its own.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-atkinson-hyperlegi: Atkinson Hyperlegible has capitals and ascenders that feel clipped beside its lowercase, with wide-set terminals on the s. And Press Start 2P brings a retro, playful grin, its softly varied strokes giving the pair a lively edge.
Approachable and a bit stencil-like, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono stretches its spacing wide open, while Press Start 2P draws a measured line like thread against yarn. Fun meets patience here.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Next reads wide-eyed, its lowercase openings big as washers. Press Start 2P is the one for retro fun with a mid-range gap between its boldest and faintest strokes, while the sans body does the quiet, open-hooked work of being read.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-biryani: Biryani reads clear and unclogged, with stems like dowels. Press Start 2P adds a faint swell in each curve, like pulled taffy, and that playful touch gives the plain sans below it something to push against.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-blinker: Blinker reads easily, its lines holding their thickness and its lowercase filling most of the height with open apertures. Press Start 2P adds gentle modulation above it for retro fun.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-carrois-gothic: Retro and a little cheeky, Press Start 2P keeps a steady line with faint modulation, big in short bursts. And Carrois Gothic sits below with a high-set x-height guide and a generous opening in the c.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC reads with a clear opening at the end of every curve and little gap between capitals and lowercase. Press Start 2P brings medium contrast without sharp hairlines, and that is the pair's real charm.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-chivo: Approachable is the mood in Chivo, whose lowercase packs up toward the caps and lets daylight through every curve. Press Start 2P does fun, retro display best; Chivo is built for the sans work of steady reading.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-chocolate-classica: Pixel-bright and playful, Press Start 2P lays down a subtle thick and thin cadence. Chocolate Classical Sans answers with a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut.
